Step inside to a light-filled floor plan featuring a beautifully updated kitchen completed in 2019. DuraCore cabinetry is complemented by DuraQuartz countertops in Santorini Ice and layered ceiling and under-cabinet lighting. The kitchen is well equipped with a 36-inch Wolf induction range, Bosch dishwasher, Urban Edge Collection under-mount sink, and Rohl faucet. Both bathrooms feature updated cabinetry, with DuraQuartz countertops in the primary bathroom. Mannington Adura-Max Gun Smoke luxury vinyl plank flooring extends throughout the bedrooms, closets, kitchen, living room, and dining room, providing a cohesive appearance and easy maintenance. The primary bedroom includes Hunter Douglas Designer Roller Shades with PowerView Gen 3 automation for convenient app-controlled light and privacy. Both bedrooms offer thoughtful closet systems that make efficient use of the available storage. A new air exchanger was installed in 2023 .Building amenities include elevator access, a shared laundry room, and a community pool. The condominium also includes one assigned subterranean parking space with a private storage cabinet. Enjoy the convenience of walking nearly everywhere from this South Lake Avenue location. The Pasadena Playhouse and Old Pasadena are also within easy reach. This well-maintained home is ready for its next owner!

results.remarks:
HOA fee includes electricity, gas, water, trash, facility maintenance, and earthquake insurance, providing exceptional value and low maintenance living. Welcome to this move in ready 2 bed 2 bath condo, ideally situated on a quiet, tree-lined street in the heart of Pasadena, adjacent to the highly desirable Madison Heights neighborhood. Offering a bright and functional floor plan, this inviting home combines tasteful upgrades with an unbeatable central location. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, abundant natural light from its sunny southern exposure, and flows seamlessly into the dining area. The kitchen showcases white shaker cabinetry, stylish countertops, and is equipped with stainless steel appliances including a stove, dishwasher, refrigerator, and beverage fridge.

The generous primary suite offers two large closets and a private ensuite bathroom, while the well sized second bedroom is filled with natural light from a large sliding glass door. Both bedrooms enjoy direct access to a private balcony overlooking mature palm trees with picturesque views of the San Gabriel Mountains. The updated hallway bathroom features a modern vanity with storage, recessed lighting, and a beautifully finished glass enclosed shower. Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning with a smart thermostat. This unit comes with 1 assigned parking spot in the gated underground garage.

The community offers onsite laundry facilities with brand new laundry machines, a community BBQ area with patio seating, and beautifully maintained common areas. Conveniently located from the 210 and 110 freeways, South Lake Avenue, Old Town Pasadena, the Playhouse District, Caltech, the Metro A Line, and countless shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations. This turnkey residence presents an outstanding opportunity to enjoy the very best of Pasadena living.

results.remarks: Sophisticated living meets every day ease. Ideally situated between Pasadena's Playhouse Village and Old Pasadena, this thoughtfully upgraded one-bedroom residence with a versatile bonus room offers the rare balance of vibrant urban living and an unexpectedly peaceful retreat. One of only a handful of homes in the building featuring a west-facing floor-to-ceiling bay window, the home is filled with golden hour light, year-round sunset views and direct views of Pasadena's iconic City Hall dome. Designed for today's flexible lifestyle, the spacious floor plan adapts effortlessly to a variety of needs. The bonus room functions beautifully as a home office, guest room or dining nook, while the generous living area accommodates entertaining, dining or a wellness space. A private balcony extends the living space outdoors, where the quiet fifth-floor, alley-facing orientation creates open city views while preserving remarkable privacy. Every finish reflects a careful balance of beauty and practicality. Italian cabinetry, a sculptural waterfall island and handcrafted Zellige tile backsplash define a kitchen that is as functional as it is visually striking. Thoughtfully selected upgrades beyond the original finishes enhance comfort and everyday living. The boutique building offers secure lobby access, a welcoming courtyard with grilling area, and an elevator-served gated parking space conveniently located near the elevator. Adjacent to Paseo Colorado and just moments from Old Pasadena, Playhouse Village, South Lake Avenue, Caltech and the Rose Bowl, the home places Pasadena's shopping, dining and cultural attractions within easy reach. The result is an urban sanctuary that feels removed from the pace of city life while remaining just steps from everything Pasadena has to offer.

results.remarks: Sensational Mid-Century light-filled condominium in an incredible location. Literally moments away from Erewhon, Loli Farms for the most amazing Peruvian chicken, Magnolia House, Noda Sushi, The Arbor and Gaucho Grill. Shopping along South Lake Avenue is abundant. For wandering around and opening your mind, Caltech is adjacent with a calendar filled with inspiring speakers and events. Further east you'll find the treasure of Pasadena, the Huntington Library and Gardens. The unit, located on the second floor with a spacious balcony has been freshly painted and offers a thoughtful floor plan with original hardwood parquet flooring and newly installed premium carpet. Storage is plentiful with cabinetry in the dining area, large closets and additional cabinetry in the primary bedroom. There are washer and dryer hookups at the entry closet AND the HOA board has approved W+D installation. Additionally, the community laundry is close at hand. Building amenities include a delightful pool and outdoor seating areas. There is one parking space in a subterranean parking garage. This is a remarkable investor or owner-occupied opportunity.

results.remarks: One of 17 meticulously designed homes which boast expansive high ceilings, elegant finishes, and spacious layouts, creating an ambiance of refined luxury. Every detail has been carefully curated to complement a cultured, upscale lifestyle, from sleek kitchens to spa-inspired bathrooms and a beautiful rooftop deck for enjoying the view and cooking at the grill with friends! Ideally situated in the famous Playhouse District, just moments from Old Pasadena, the Huntington Gardens, California Institute of Technology, and the city's thriving medical and tech corridor, Uptown Condos offers a tranquil retreat close to Downtown Los Angeles--without the hustle and congestion. Developed by a local builder with a strong track record of creating exceptional condominiums throughout Pasadena, Uptown Condos reflects a deep commitment to quality and the community. With secure parking, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location, Uptown Condos is the ultimate destination for anyone looking to elevate their lifestyle in Pasadena or the surrounding community. results.remarks:
Residence #103 at 150 S Oak Knoll offers clean, modern living in the heart of Pasadena's Playhouse Village. The home is bright and comfortable, with warm wood tones, understated contemporary finishes, and an easy sense of calm. The kitchen is beautifully finished with sleek wood-grain cabinetry, premium stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a full-height backsplash, connecting effortlessly to the dining and living areas. From the dining area, olive trees and distant palms frame the view.

Large glass doors extend the living room to a private patio, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. From here, views stretch north toward the San Gabriel Mountains, bringing natural light and a sense of openness into the home. The thoughtfully designed floor plan makes efficient use of every space, with a spacious bedroom, in-unit laundry, and a layout that feels both practical and inviting.

Life here extends beyond the residence itself. The fourth- and fifth-floor rooftop gardens offer beautifully designed outdoor spaces with lounge seating, barbecue areas, dining tables, and fire pits. Whether gathering with friends, enjoying a quiet morning coffee, watching the sunset, or taking in views of the surrounding palm trees and mountain backdrop, these rooftop retreats provide a unique extension of everyday living.

This brand-new condominium community was designed for a more contemporary way of life—open, connected, and uplifting. It is a home designed not simply as a place to live, but as a place to enjoy life: connected to the city, open to the sky, and centered around comfort, community, and everyday moments.

results.remarks: Turnkey single-level condo situated two blocks west of Lake Avenue and two blocks south of Colorado Blvd. This recently renovated corner unit, built in 1988, offers a superb location in the heart of Pasadena. Oak Knoll Terrace is a secure and well-maintained community featuring abundant mature trees, lush planters, and a community pool. The neighborhood includes a mix of residential and commercial properties, offering close proximity to public transportation, shops, restaurants, and markets, as well as the California Institute of Technology, Pasadena Playhouse, and Old Pasadena. This move-in-ready, 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit includes two large balconies, providing approximately 300 SF+/- of private outdoor space. The unit has two side-by-side parking spaces in the secure community garage and in-unit laundry. Both bedrooms have large closets with direct access to the spacious private balcony. The property blends functional design elements—such as 9-foot ceilings, calming natural light, ample room sizes, luxury vinyl plank floors, and plentiful storage—while presenting a clean and contemporary aesthetic. The indoor-outdoor flow of this 1,250 SF+/- (per LA County Assessor) one-level property make it feel larger than the SF number suggests. Light and bright, this unit recently underwent substantial cosmetic upgrades, including new interior paint, new recessed lighting, new lighting fixtures, and new plumbing fixtures. Other aspects of this property that will satisfy selective buyers include the decorative fireplace, an extra-large dining room, and new quartz countertops in the kitchen and bathrooms. This unit also comes with all appliances included: stainless-steel refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, and stove, as well as a stackable washer and dryer in a hallway closet. The monthly HOA covers exterior maintenance, roof, water, trash, sewer, gardener, elevator, earthquake insurance, community insurance, and professional management. Pets are also permitted - two animals, dogs and/or cats are welcome. Easy access was a priority when this building was designed because the unit can be reached without going up a single step, via elevator access from the garage or the ramp located at the front of the building. Whether you are looking for a wonderful starter home, a modern pied-a-terre, or a comfortable space during retirement, this unit can work for all buyers.
